description: This header file declares utility functions for managing cuttlefish instances, including stopping all instances and killing server processes.

methods.name: KillAllCuttlefishInstances
methods.description: Stops all running cuttlefish instances by identifying run_cvd processes and sending SIGKILL signals, with an option to clear runtime directories.

methods.name: ForcefullyStopGroup
methods.description: Forcefully stops a process group identified by the provided uid_t identifier.

methods.name: KillCvdServerProcess
methods.description: Terminates the cuttlefish CVD server process.
